Checking an online plugin before installing it, or dealing with an installed plugin that fails to load, now works smoothly.

Besides local folders, `agy plugin validate` now accepts `.zip` files, `https://` links, and GitHub URLs. When a plugin lives in a subfolder, use `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>` instead.

Some Windows editors add a UTF-8 BOM (a hidden encoding marker character) to the start of `plugin.json`. Previously, such files were rejected by this command and failed to load even when `agy plugin install` reported success, and this is now fixed. ⟦Think of inspecting a parcel from out of town right at the doorstep without bringing it inside, so even an extra hidden stamp at the top of the manifest will not get it rejected or leave it unopenable after delivery.⟧

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` so you can check a plugin before you install it: besides a local folder, it now accepts a plugin `.zip` file, an `https://` link to one, or a GitHub repository URL, using `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<branch>/<path>` for a plugin in a subfolder.
Fixed plugins whose `plugin.json` starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as some Windows editors save it, not loading even though `agy plugin install` reported success, and `agy plugin validate` rejecting them.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁的檔案分頁預設收起側欄
title.en: File Tabs in Remote Control Browser View Collapse Sidebar by Default

body.zh-TW: 想在側邊面板專心看內容，以前只要畫面夠寬，旁邊的樹狀清單就會自己跳出來把正文擠窄。現在遠端控制網頁開啟檔案或產出物（AI 產生的獨立成果檔）分頁時，會先把側邊欄收起來，讓內容用滿整個面板寬度。如果想看檔案樹或產出物清單，點分頁頂端的 `Toggle sidebar` 還是能展開。⟦翻開書桌上的資料夾時，以前只要桌面夠寬，旁邊的目錄頁就會自動攤開佔掉一半位子；現在預設先把目錄收進側邊，讓你用整面寬度看正文，需要對照時再手動翻開。⟧
body.en: When you wanted to focus on content in the side panel, the tree list beside it used to pop open on its own and squeeze the main text whenever the window was wide enough. Now, when opening a file or artifact (a standalone output file generated by the AI) tab in the Remote Control browser view, the sidebar starts collapsed so the content fills the full panel width. If you want to see the file tree or artifact list, you can still expand it by clicking `Toggle sidebar` at the top of the tab. ⟦Like opening a folder on a desk where the table of contents used to unfold on its own and take up half the space whenever the desk was wide enough, it now tucks the index aside by default so you can read across the full width and flip it open by hand when you need to cross-check.⟧

items.original: Changed file and artifact tabs in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view to open with their sidebar closed, so the file or artifact gets the panel's full width; previously the file tree or artifact list opened on its own whenever the panel was wide enough, and you can still open it with `Toggle sidebar` in the tab's header.

title.zh-TW: 用 GEMINI_API_KEY 時修好額度查詢空轉
title.en: Fixed Quota Commands Hanging When Using GEMINI_API_KEY

body.zh-TW: 用自己的 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（直接呼叫模型的個人金鑰）連線，因為沒有帳號額度可查，過去跑 `/usage`、`/quota` 或 `/credits` 會一直載入或顯示空白。現在這三個指令會從自動補全與 `/help` 清單裡拿掉。直接執行它們時，畫面會說明原因並引導你去 AI Studio 查看金鑰用量；在 `-p` 執行時，則會回傳結束碼 2 並退出。⟦拿單次儲值卡去結帳，螢幕原本還讓你點會員紅利查詢，結果卡在轉圈圈；現在櫃檯直接把這幾顆按鈕從選單拿掉，硬按的話也會請你改去發卡處看明細。⟧
body.en: When connecting with your own `GEMINI_API_KEY` (a personal key for calling models directly), running `/usage`, `/quota`, or `/credits` used to spin forever or show a blank screen because there is no account quota to display. These three commands are now removed from autocomplete and the `/help` list. Running them directly explains why and directs you to AI Studio to check key usage, while running in `-p` mode exits with code 2. ⟦Imagine paying with a single-use prepaid card while the checkout screen still lets you tap a loyalty points check that just spins endlessly, so the counter removes those buttons from the menu and tells you to check details with the card issuer if you press them anyway.⟧

items.original: Fixed `/usage`, `/quota`, and `/credits` loading forever or showing an empty quota when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, which has no account quota to show; they are now left out of autocomplete and `/help`, running one explains why and points you to the key's usage in AI Studio, and in `-p` runs they exit with code 2.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁版修好較大附件上傳失敗
title.en: Fixed Larger Attachment Uploads Failing in Remote Control Browser View

body.zh-TW: 想把照片或影片夾帶傳給 AI，過去只要檔案超過幾 MB 就會卡住送不出去。這個問題在遠端控制網頁版已經修好，現在最大 20 MB 的附件都能正常上傳。
body.en: When attaching photos or videos to send to the AI, files larger than a few MB used to get stuck and fail to upload. This is now fixed in the Remote Control browser view, and attachments up to 20 MB upload normally.

items.original: Fixed files larger than a few megabytes, such as photos and videos, failing to upload when you attach them in the Remote Control browser view; attachments up to 20 MB now upload.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁修好長對話點選引用沒反應
title.en: Fixed Clicking Quotes in Long Remote Control Conversations Doing Nothing

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 聊了很多輪之後，想點開自己訊息裡摘錄的舊段落回頭對照，如果那段話在太前面還沒載入，以前畫面會完全不動。這個問題在遠端控制網頁版已經修好，現在畫面會先載入那一段對話，再捲動到引用的位置。
body.en: After chatting with the AI for many turns, clicking a quoted passage in your own message to jump back for reference used to do nothing if that passage was too far back to have loaded yet. This is now fixed in the Remote Control browser view, which loads that part of the conversation first and then scrolls to the quoted spot.

items.original: Fixed clicking a quote in one of your messages in the Remote Control browser view doing nothing when the quoted passage was too far back in a long conversation to have loaded yet; the view now loads that part of the conversation and scrolls to the passage.

title.zh-TW: 安裝 CLI 不再把例行進度誤印成錯誤
title.en: CLI Installation No Longer Prints Routine Progress as Errors

body.zh-TW: 安裝 CLI（命令列介面工具）的過程中，過去明明裝得順利，畫面上卻會冒出以 `ERROR: logging before google.Init` 開頭的例行進度訊息，讓人誤以為安裝失敗。這個問題已經修好，例行進度不再被印成這串錯誤字樣。
body.en: During installation of the CLI (command-line interface tool), routine progress messages starting with `ERROR: logging before google.Init` used to appear even when everything installed smoothly, making it look like the setup had failed. This is now fixed so routine progress is no longer printed with that error prefix.

items.original: Fixed installing the CLI printing routine progress messages as lines starting with `ERROR: logging before google.Init`, which made a successful install look like it had failed.

entries: Added `accept-edits` mode to `--remote-agent` sessions: `Shift+Tab` now switches between the default mode and `accept-edits` instead of doing nothing. Sessions still start in the default mode, where the remote agent now asks before each file edit in its workspace, so you may see edit approval prompts you didn't get before; switch to `accept-edits` to let edits go ahead without asking.

Added the Orchestrator model to `/model` for Gemini Enterprise accounts and sign-ins with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`): it plans with Gemini 4 Carbon (High) and hands the plan's execution to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), and it appears when you can select both of those models.

Added a conversation navigator to the Remote Control browser view: a rail with a mark for each of your prompts previews the prompt when you hover over it and jumps to it when you click, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next prompt.
Added a `Quote` button to the Remote Control browser view: select text in an agent response and click `Quote` to add it to your next message as a quote.

Added clickable links to the message box and your sent messages in the Remote Control browser view: a web address you type or paste opens with `Cmd+click` (`Ctrl+click` on Windows and Linux) or a middle-click, while a plain click still places the cursor.

Added the time left to timers the agent sets, in the Remote Control browser view: each running timer in `Background Tasks` shows a countdown such as `59m left`, and when a timer is all that's running, the status line reads, for example, `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

Improved rate-limit handling: when the model API asks the CLI to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits and retries for delays of up to 4 minutes instead of stopping the turn when the delay is longer than 30 seconds, so per-minute rate and capacity limits no longer end your turn, while spend-cap, prepaid-balance, and weekly quota errors now stop the turn right away.

Improved `/model` when your plan offers more than one Orchestrator planner: the separate `Orchestrator (Carbon)` and `Orchestrator (Argon)` rows are now a single `Orchestrator` row with a `Planner` choice that you change with `←`/`→` or `Tab`, while `--model` and saved settings keep using the full names.

Improved switching to a conversation that's already open in long sessions: `/resume <id>` back to it and the switch after `/fork` no longer load the conversation's whole history first, so they no longer pause for a second or more, and `/btw` and `/help` side questions start faster too.

Improved memory use in long sessions: the CLI now keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when it needs them, instead of holding every step for as long as the conversation is open, and it no longer loads every earlier subagent's full history at the start of each turn, which could take several GiB in sessions that ran many subagents.

Improved click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: items you can click, such as `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt, now highlight when you hover over them.

Improved the side panel in the Remote Control browser view: files and reviews open in tabs that come back when you reload the page, and a new Overview Panel, opened from the title bar or with `Cmd+Option+O` (`Ctrl+Alt+O` on Windows and Linux), lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks.

Changed the terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/.config` (or your `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) and, on Windows, `AppData\Roaming` by default, since other programs keep settings and tokens there; previously they were readable. The settings of common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python stay readable, `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked, and you can still allow other paths explicitly in your sandbox rules.
Fixed Auto mode asking for approval to read files outside the workspace even when `Non-Workspace Access` is turned on in `/config`; Auto mode now honors that setting.

Fixed long, high-effort model responses being canceled and restarted from scratch when the model went more than 5 minutes without sending anything while it was still thinking; the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes before it treats a silent response as stalled.

Fixed turns failing with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or the conversation compacting far earlier than needed, after the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation's first compaction.

Fixed a rare race that could leave a new conversation unusable, with every message failing with `trajectory not found` even after a restart, when the conversation was created while the CLI was listing saved conversations, such as at startup or when an editor connected through `agy acp` refreshed its session list.

Fixed `agy acp` holding back what the agent did after a turn ended: when a background task or subagent finishes and wakes the agent, its replies, tool calls, and permission requests now reach the editor right away instead of at your next prompt, so the agent no longer waits on a permission request the editor never showed.

Fixed `agy acp` leaving a session's subagents and background tasks, such as dev servers, running after the editor canceled a prompt or closed the session, where they could keep working and wake the conversation again; canceling or closing now stops them, and closing does so even when no prompt is running.

Fixed signing in to a plugin right after installing it from `/plugin`, where pasting the code from its sign-in page could fail with "The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."

Fixed plugins running while your organization turns them off with `pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings: plugin MCP servers and other plugin processes no longer start before sign-in finishes, and they now stop as soon as an administrator turns plugins off during a session.

Fixed skills whose `SKILL.md` has no `name` in its frontmatter: they were all named `SKILL`, so only the first one loaded and the rest were silently dropped; each is now named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

Fixed the agent writing LF line endings when it appends to a file that uses CRLF line endings, as is common on Windows, which left the file with mixed line endings and made later multi-line edits to it fail with `target content not found`; appended text now uses the file's own line endings.

Fixed OSC 7501 terminal status showing the session as done while the agent was paused waiting for background subagents or tasks to finish; the terminal's tab or window now shows it as working until that work ends, and daemon tasks such as dev servers don't count.

Fixed typing in the Remote Control browser view: with Chrome on Android, `Backspace` on the on-screen keyboard could stop deleting characters and later text could land in the middle of a word, and after typing with an input method or a phone keyboard's suggestions, `Enter` could add a new line instead of sending your message.
Fixed scrolling up through a long agent turn in the Remote Control browser view, where the view could jump back down instead of reaching your prompt.

Fixed the permission prompt in the Remote Control browser view letting the number or arrow keys select and submit an unavailable "always allow" option when one of your ask rules or a hook requires you to confirm each time; the keyboard now skips those options, as clicking already did.

Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view switching to `No Model Selected` after a brief connection or server error; it now keeps your account and model list until the next successful refresh.

title.zh-TW: --remote-agent 新增編輯自動放行模式
title.en: --remote-agent adds accept-edits mode

body.zh-TW:
開啟遠端代理工作階段後，現在每改動工作區裡的檔案前都會跳出詢問，跟以前直接改完不太一樣。覺得逐一確認太繁瑣，按 `Shift+Tab` 就能在預設模式與 `accept-edits` 模式之間切換，不再沒反應。

新開啟的工作階段依然從預設模式開始，切到 `accept-edits` 後，代理改檔案就會直接進行、不再每次發問。⟦交給剪輯師修影片時，預設改成他每剪一刀都先給你看過才動手；確認方向對了，再切到直接放行模式讓他順順改下去。⟧
body.en:
After starting a remote agent session, it now prompts before changing any file in the workspace, unlike before when it edited directly. If confirming each change feels tedious, pressing `Shift+Tab` toggles between the default mode and `accept-edits` mode instead of doing nothing.

New sessions still start in the default mode, and switching to `accept-edits` lets the agent edit files directly without asking each time. ⟦When handing a video to a film editor, the default now has them check with you before every cut; once you are sure the direction is right, switch to direct approval mode so they can keep editing smoothly.⟧

items.original: Added `accept-edits` mode to `--remote-agent` sessions: `Shift+Tab` now switches between the default mode and `accept-edits` instead of doing nothing. Sessions still start in the default mode, where the remote agent now asks before each file edit in its workspace, so you may see edit approval prompts you didn't get before; switch to `accept-edits` to let edits go ahead without asking.

title.zh-TW: /model 新增 Orchestrator 模型
title.en: /model adds the Orchestrator model

body.zh-TW:
以 Gemini Enterprise 帳號或 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 應用程式預設憑證登入，若帳號能選取 Carbon 與 Hydrogen 這兩個模型，`/model` 就會出現 `Orchestrator`。它會先讓 Gemini 4 Carbon (High) 擬定計畫。接著交由 Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High) 接手執行。

方案若含多種規劃者，`Orchestrator (Carbon)` 會整併進單一 `Orchestrator` 列。另一列 `Orchestrator (Argon)` 也收進來，可用 `←`、`→` 或 `Tab` 切換 `Planner`。至於 `--model` 指令參數與已存設定，仍使用原本的完整名稱。⟦裝潢房子時，一位建築師先畫好整套藍圖，再交給工班主任按圖施工，你也能在同一窗口直接指定建築師。⟧
body.en:
When signed in with a Gemini Enterprise account or `AGY_ADC_AUTH` Application Default Credentials, `Orchestrator` appears in `/model` if your account can select both Carbon and Hydrogen. It first has Gemini 4 Carbon (High) draft a plan. Then it hands execution off to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High).

If your plan includes multiple planners, `Orchestrator (Carbon)` is merged into a single `Orchestrator` row. The `Orchestrator (Argon)` row is folded in too, and you can switch `Planner` using `←`, `→`, or `Tab`. Meanwhile, `--model` flags and saved settings still use the original full names. ⟦During a home renovation, one architect draws up the full blueprint and then hands it to a site foreman to build from, and you can pick the architect right from the same contact.⟧

items.original:
Added the Orchestrator model to `/model` for Gemini Enterprise accounts and sign-ins with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`): it plans with Gemini 4 Carbon (High) and hands the plan's execution to Gemini 4 Hydrogen (High), and it appears when you can select both of those models.
Improved `/model` when your plan offers more than one Orchestrator planner: the separate `Orchestrator (Carbon)` and `Orchestrator (Argon)` rows are now a single `Orchestrator` row with a `Planner` choice that you change with `←`/`→` or `Tab`, while `--model` and saved settings keep using the full names.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁新增對話導覽軌道
title.en: Remote Control browser view adds conversation navigator rail

body.zh-TW:
在長對話裡來回翻找先前的指令，滑鼠滾輪常要捲老半天。遠端控制網頁版新增了對話導覽軌道，你送出的每則提問都會在軌道上留下一道標記。

把游標停在標記上就能預覽該則提問，點一下直接跳過去；習慣用鍵盤的話，按 `[` 或 `]` 也能跳到上一則或下一則提問。⟦聽長篇廣播節目時，以前想找前面某段得一路盲拉進度條，現在軸線上直接標出每個段落，停上去預覽、點一下就能直達。⟧
body.en:
Scrolling back through a long conversation to find earlier prompts often takes ages with a mouse wheel. The Remote Control browser view now includes a conversation navigator rail that leaves a mark on the track for every prompt you send.

Hover over a mark to preview that prompt and click to jump straight to it; if you prefer the keyboard, press `[` or `]` to jump to the previous or next prompt. ⟦Listening to a long radio show used to mean blindly dragging the progress bar to find an earlier segment, whereas now every segment is marked right on the timeline so you can hover to preview and click to jump straight there.⟧

items.original: Added a conversation navigator to the Remote Control browser view: a rail with a mark for each of your prompts previews the prompt when you hover over it and jumps to it when you click, and `[` and `]` jump to the previous or next prompt.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁新增 Quote 引用按鈕
title.en: Remote Control browser view adds Quote button

body.zh-TW: 想針對代理長篇回覆裡的某一段繼續追問，現在不必自己手動複製再整理。在遠端控制網頁版選取代理回覆中的任意文字，點擊 `Quote` 按鈕，這段話就會以引用格式放進你的下一則訊息。
body.en: When you want to follow up on one part of a long agent response, you no longer have to copy and format it by hand. Select any text in an agent response in the Remote Control browser view and click the `Quote` button to insert that passage as a quote into your next message.

items.original: Added a `Quote` button to the Remote Control browser view: select text in an agent response and click `Quote` to add it to your next message as a quote.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁的網址可按鍵直接開啟
title.en: Links in Remote Control browser view open directly on click

body.zh-TW:
訊息裡貼了網址想順手點開，過去還得反白複製到新分頁。輸入框裡打好的網址，以及你已送出的訊息裡的網址，現在都能直接點開。

在 Mac 按 `Cmd+click`、Windows 與 Linux 按 `Ctrl+click`，或按滑鼠中鍵就能開啟連結，單純左鍵點擊依然只會放置游標。
body.en:
Opening a URL pasted into a message used to mean highlighting it and copying it into a new tab. Web addresses typed in the message box and those in your sent messages can now be opened directly.

On Mac, use `Cmd+click`, on Windows and Linux use `Ctrl+click`, or middle-click to open the link, while a plain left-click still just places the cursor.

items.original: Added clickable links to the message box and your sent messages in the Remote Control browser view: a web address you type or paste opens with `Cmd+click` (`Ctrl+click` on Windows and Linux) or a middle-click, while a plain click still places the cursor.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁計時器顯示剩餘倒數
title.en: Timers show remaining countdown in Remote Control browser view

body.zh-TW:
代理在背景設定計時器後，你不用自己推算還要等多久。遠端控制網頁版的 `Background Tasks` 清單裡，每個運作中的計時器都會顯示像 `59m left` 這樣的剩餘倒數。

若是當下只有計時器在跑，狀態列也會跟著顯示例如 `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left` 的進度。
body.en:
Once the agent sets a timer in the background, you no longer have to calculate how much longer to wait. In the Remote Control browser view's `Background Tasks` list, each running timer shows a remaining countdown like `59m left`.

If a timer is the only thing running at that moment, the status line also shows progress such as `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

items.original: Added the time left to timers the agent sets, in the Remote Control browser view: each running timer in `Background Tasks` shows a countdown such as `59m left`, and when a timer is all that's running, the status line reads, for example, `Waiting for 1h timer · 59m left`.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁側邊欄保留分頁並增設總覽
title.en: Remote Control browser view side panel keeps tabs and adds Overview

body.zh-TW:
遠端控制網頁版把頁面重整後，原本打開的檔案或檢視畫面不再跟著消失。側邊欄裡開啟的檔案與檢視內容現在會以分頁保留，重新整理網頁後照樣會恢復。

側邊欄也新增了 Overview Panel，可從標題列點開，或按 `Cmd+Option+O` 叫出。Windows 與 Linux 快捷鍵則是 `Ctrl+Alt+O`，裡面會列出對話的產物、修改過的檔案、子代理與背景任務。⟦辦活動時，以前重整場地就把各組資料夾全收掉，現在攤開的分頁都留在原位，旁邊還多了張總表一次看清誰在忙什麼。⟧
body.en:
Reloading the Remote Control browser view no longer wipes out the files or reviews you had open. Files and views opened in the side panel are now kept as tabs and are restored after a page reload.

The side panel also adds an Overview Panel, which you can open from the title bar or by pressing `Cmd+Option+O`. On Windows and Linux, the shortcut is `Ctrl+Alt+O`, and it lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks. ⟦Think of running an event: tidying up the venue used to mean packing away every team's folder, whereas now the open tabs stay right where they are, with a summary sheet beside them showing who is working on what at a glance.⟧

items.original: Improved the side panel in the Remote Control browser view: files and reviews open in tabs that come back when you reload the page, and a new Overview Panel, opened from the title bar or with `Cmd+Option+O` (`Ctrl+Alt+O` on Windows and Linux), lists the conversation's artifacts, modified files, subagents, and background tasks.

title.zh-TW: 限流等待重試上限放寬至 4 分鐘
title.en: Rate-limit retry wait raised to 4 minutes

body.zh-TW:
模型暫時塞車，這一輪對話不會動不動就被迫中斷。當模型介面要求稍候再試，指令列工具現在會等到最多 4 分鐘並自動重試，不再像過去只要等待超過 30 秒就直接結束這一輪。

因此每分鐘頻率限制與容量上限不會再打斷你的進度；不過一旦遇到消費上限、預付餘額不足或每週額度用盡的錯誤，則會立刻停止該輪。⟦排熱門餐廳一樣，以前等超過半分鐘沒位子就直接走人，現在只要還會翻桌就願意多等一會；但要是折價券或額度用光，就立刻改天再來。⟧
body.en:
Temporary model congestion no longer cuts your turn short so easily. When the model API asks to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits up to 4 minutes and retries automatically, instead of ending the turn as soon as the wait exceeded 30 seconds.

As a result, per-minute rate limits and capacity limits no longer interrupt your progress; however, spend-cap, insufficient prepaid-balance, or weekly quota exhaustion errors will stop the turn right away. ⟦Picture waiting in line at a popular restaurant: you used to walk away if there was no table within half a minute, and now you are willing to wait a bit longer as long as tables are turning over, though if your vouchers or balance run out, you immediately come back another day.⟧

items.original: Improved rate-limit handling: when the model API asks the CLI to wait before retrying, the CLI now waits and retries for delays of up to 4 minutes instead of stopping the turn when the delay is longer than 30 seconds, so per-minute rate and capacity limits no longer end your turn, while spend-cap, prepaid-balance, and weekly quota errors now stop the turn right away.

title.zh-TW: 長工作階段切換對話更快也更省記憶體
title.en: Faster conversation switching and lower memory use in long sessions

body.zh-TW:
對話開久了之後來回切換，常會卡頓又佔記憶體。現在用 `/resume <id>` 切回已開啟的對話，或用 `/fork` 分岔後切換，都不再先把整份歷史載入，因此不再停頓一秒以上。`/btw` 和 `/help` 這類旁白提問也啟動得更快。

記憶體管理也跟著調整：工作階段開啟期間，指令列工具只保留最近用到的對話步驟，舊步驟等需要時再從硬碟重讀。每輪開始時也不再載入先前所有子代理的完整紀錄，跑過大量子代理時原本可能吃掉數 GiB 的空間。⟦在廚房備料時，以前把整週食材全攤在流理台差點沒位子切菜，現在只留當下要用的，其餘先收進儲藏室隨用隨拿。⟧
body.en:
Switching back and forth in long-running conversations often lags and eats up memory. Now, switching back to an open conversation with `/resume <id>` or switching after `/fork` no longer loads the entire history first, eliminating pauses of a second or more. Side questions like `/btw` and `/help` also start faster.

Memory management has been adjusted as well: while a session is open, the CLI keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when needed. It also no longer loads the full history of all previous subagents at the start of each turn, which could otherwise consume several GiB when many subagents had run. ⟦Prepping ingredients in a kitchen used to mean spreading a whole week's groceries across the counter until there was barely room to chop, whereas now only what you need right away stays out and the rest waits in the pantry to be grabbed on demand.⟧

items.original:
Improved switching to a conversation that's already open in long sessions: `/resume <id>` back to it and the switch after `/fork` no longer load the conversation's whole history first, so they no longer pause for a second or more, and `/btw` and `/help` side questions start faster too.
Improved memory use in long sessions: the CLI now keeps only recently used conversation steps in memory and reloads older ones from disk when it needs them, instead of holding every step for as long as the conversation is open, and it no longer loads every earlier subagent's full history at the start of each turn, which could take several GiB in sessions that ran many subagents.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式可點擊項目懸停會發亮
title.en: Clickable items highlight on hover in full screen mode

body.zh-TW:
使用 `full screen (altscreen)` 全螢幕模式，游標移過去常分不清哪裡能點開。現在只要把游標停在可點擊的項目上，畫面就會高亮標示。

這些項目包含 `(ctrl+o to expand)` 展開提示、思考內容、展開後的工具群組，以及釘選在畫面的提問。
body.en:
In `full screen (altscreen)` mode, it was often hard to tell what could be clicked when moving the cursor around. Now, hovering over any clickable item highlights it on screen.

These items include `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt.

items.original: Improved click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: items you can click, such as `(ctrl+o to expand)` hints, thoughts, expanded tool groups, and the pinned prompt, now highlight when you hover over them.

title.zh-TW: 終端機沙盒預設封鎖讀取設定目錄
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Blocks Reading Config Directories by Default

body.zh-TW:
許多軟體會把帳號設定與 token（授權令牌）存在系統資料夾，過去受限指令也能直接查看。現在終端機沙盒預設會擋下 `~/.config` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`，在 Windows 也會擋下 `AppData\Roaming`。

不過 Git、Go、npm 與 Python 等常見開發工具的設定依然可以讀取，而 `~/.git-credentials` 則改為預設封鎖。如果確實需要讓指令讀取其他路徑，你還是能在沙盒規則裡明確放行。⟦請人來家裡修家電時，以前連臥室抽屜都沒關任他查看，現在先把放存摺和印章的抽屜鎖好，只留維修需要的工具箱。⟧
body.en:
Many programs store account settings and tokens (authentication credentials) in system folders, which restricted commands could previously read directly. Now, the terminal sandbox blocks `~/.config` or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` by default, and also blocks `AppData\Roaming` on Windows.

However, settings for common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python remain readable, while `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked by default. If you genuinely need a command to read other paths, you can still allow them explicitly in your sandbox rules. ⟦Inviting a technician to repair an appliance at home used to mean leaving bedroom drawers open for them to look through; now you lock the drawer holding your bankbook and stamps first, leaving out only the toolbox needed for the repair.⟧

items.original: Changed the terminal sandbox to block sandboxed commands from reading `~/.config` (or your `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`) and, on Windows, `AppData\Roaming` by default, since other programs keep settings and tokens there; previously they were readable. The settings of common developer tools such as Git, Go, npm, and Python stay readable, `~/.git-credentials` is now blocked, and you can still allow other paths explicitly in your sandbox rules.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Auto 模式忽略工作區外存取設定
title.en: Fix Auto Mode Ignoring Non-Workspace Access Setting

body.zh-TW: 明明已在 `/config` 開啟 `Non-Workspace Access`，讓工具讀取工作區以外的檔案，以前在 Auto 模式下卻還是會跳出核准詢問。這個問題已經修好，Auto 模式現在會依照這項設定放行。
body.en: Even when `Non-Workspace Access` was turned on in `/config` so tools could read files outside the workspace, Auto mode still prompted for approval. This issue is fixed, and Auto mode now honors that setting.

items.original: Fixed Auto mode asking for approval to read files outside the workspace even when `Non-Workspace Access` is turned on in `/config`; Auto mode now honors that setting.

title.zh-TW: 高思考強度長回覆靜默上限延至 10 分鐘
title.en: Extend Silent Timeout to 10 Minutes for High-Effort Responses

body.zh-TW: 請模型進行高思考強度的長篇處理時，以前只要它在思考過程中超過 5 分鐘沒有回傳任何內容，就會被判定卡住而整段取消重來。這個問題已經修好，指令列工具現在最多會等待 10 分鐘。
body.en: When asking the model for long, high-effort processing, any pause of more than 5 minutes without returning content while thinking previously caused it to be treated as stalled and canceled from scratch. This issue is fixed, and the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes.

items.original: Fixed long, high-effort model responses being canceled and restarted from scratch when the model went more than 5 minutes without sending anything while it was still thinking; the CLI now waits up to 10 minutes before it treats a silent response as stalled.

title.zh-TW: 修正讀取超大檔案後報錯或過早壓縮
title.en: Fix Errors or Early Compaction After Reading Large Files

body.zh-TW: 對話還沒壓縮過，就讓代理讀取動輒好幾 MB 的 PDF 等超大檔案，過去很容易出狀況。這一輪可能會報錯 `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`，或是遠早於需要時就提前壓縮，現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: If the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation was compacted, things could easily go wrong. That turn could fail with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or compact far earlier than needed, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed turns failing with `model output must contain either output text or tool calls`, or the conversation compacting far earlier than needed, after the agent read very large files, such as multi-megabyte PDFs, before the conversation's first compaction.

title.zh-TW: 修正特定時機新建對話失效問題
title.en: Fix New Conversations Failing at Specific Timing

body.zh-TW: 指令列工具剛啟動，或透過 `agy acp` 連線的編輯器正在重整已存工作階段清單的瞬間建立新對話，過去偶爾會發生順序衝突。這會讓新對話每則訊息都報錯 `trajectory not found`，連重開都救不回，現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: Starting a new conversation right as the CLI launched or while an editor connected through `agy acp` was refreshing its saved session list could occasionally hit a race condition. That left every message in the new conversation failing with `trajectory not found`, unrecoverable even after a restart, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed a rare race that could leave a new conversation unusable, with every message failing with `trajectory not found` even after a restart, when the conversation was created while the CLI was listing saved conversations, such as at startup or when an editor connected through `agy acp` refreshed its session list.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy acp 背景任務回報與停止時機
title.en: Fix agy acp Background Task Reporting and Stop Timing

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把代理接進編輯器後，該輪結束時若背景任務或子代理完成並喚醒代理，過去回覆、工具呼叫和權限請求會被扣住，等到你送出下一句才看得到。現在這些訊息會即時送到編輯器，代理不再卡在編輯器根本沒顯示的權限詢問上。

當編輯器取消提示詞或關閉工作階段後，屬於該工作階段的子代理與開發伺服器等背景任務，過去會繼續留在背景運作、甚至重新喚醒對話。現在取消或關閉都會把它們停下來，而且關閉工作階段時，就算沒有提示詞在執行也照樣停止。
body.en:
After connecting the agent to an editor via `agy acp`, if a background task or subagent finished after a turn ended and woke the agent, replies, tool calls, and permission requests were previously held back until you sent your next message. Now those messages reach the editor right away, so the agent no longer stalls on a permission prompt the editor never showed.

Previously, when the editor canceled a prompt or closed a session, subagents and background tasks belonging to that session, such as dev servers, kept running in the background and could even wake the conversation again. Now canceling or closing stops them, and closing a session stops them even when no prompt is running.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` holding back what the agent did after a turn ended: when a background task or subagent finishes and wakes the agent, its replies, tool calls, and permission requests now reach the editor right away instead of at your next prompt, so the agent no longer waits on a permission request the editor never showed.
Fixed `agy acp` leaving a session's subagents and background tasks, such as dev servers, running after the editor canceled a prompt or closed the session, where they could keep working and wake the conversation again; canceling or closing now stops them, and closing does so even when no prompt is running.

title.zh-TW: 外掛啟停登入與技能命名修復
title.en: Fix Plugin Sign-In, Admin Toggling, and Skill Naming

body.zh-TW:
從 `/plugin` 裝完外掛立刻登入並貼上代碼，過去可能會失敗。畫面會顯示 `"The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."`。這個登入問題現在已經修好。

若管理員在受管設定以 `pluginsDisabled` 停用外掛，外掛的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器與程序不會再於登入前啟動。工作階段途中一旦被管理員關閉，它們也會立刻停止。

當技能的 `SKILL.md` 開頭欄位沒寫 `name`，過去全都叫 `SKILL`，只載入第一個而略過其餘。現在會改用所屬資料夾命名，`agy plugin validate` 也會回報該名稱。
body.en:
Signing in and pasting the code right after installing a plugin from `/plugin` could previously fail. The screen displayed `"The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."`. This sign-in issue is now fixed.

When an administrator disables plugins in managed settings using `pluginsDisabled`, plugin MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers and processes no longer start before sign-in. If an administrator turns them off mid-session, they also stop immediately.

When a skill's `SKILL.md` frontmatter omitted `name`, all of them were previously named `SKILL`, so only the first loaded and the rest were skipped. Now each is named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

items.original:
Fixed signing in to a plugin right after installing it from `/plugin`, where pasting the code from its sign-in page could fail with "The sign-in link changed. Open the new one above, then paste its code."
Fixed plugins running while your organization turns them off with `pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings: plugin MCP servers and other plugin processes no longer start before sign-in finishes, and they now stop as soon as an administrator turns plugins off during a session.
Fixed skills whose `SKILL.md` has no `name` in its frontmatter: they were all named `SKILL`, so only the first one loaded and the rest were silently dropped; each is now named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` reports that name.

title.zh-TW: 修正尾端追加文字混雜換行格式錯誤
title.en: Fix Mixed Line Endings When Appending to Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 開啟慣用 CRLF 結尾的檔案並從最後一行接續寫入，代理以前會寫成 LF。這會讓同一份檔案夾雜兩種斷行，後續多行修改就會跳出 `target content not found`。這個問題已經修好，現在追加的文字會沿用檔案原本的換行格式。
body.en: On Windows, when opening a file that uses CRLF endings and appending to the last line, the agent previously wrote LF. That left the file with mixed line endings, causing later multi-line edits to fail with `target content not found`. This issue is fixed, and appended text now uses the file's original line endings.

items.original: Fixed the agent writing LF line endings when it appends to a file that uses CRLF line endings, as is common on Windows, which left the file with mixed line endings and made later multi-line edits to it fail with `target content not found`; appended text now uses the file's own line endings.

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機等待背景工作時誤顯完成
title.en: Fix Terminal Showing Done While Waiting on Background Work

body.zh-TW: 你把子代理或任務放去背後跑、代理正停下來等結果，以前 OSC 7501 狀態列會先把這個工作階段標示為結束。這個問題已經修好，現在分頁或視窗會保持在執行中直到工作完成，不過像開發伺服器這類常駐任務不計算在內。
body.en: When you sent a subagent or task to the background and the agent paused to wait for results, the OSC 7501 status bar previously marked the session as done. This issue is fixed, so the tab or window now stays in the working state until that work finishes, though daemon tasks such as dev servers do not count.

items.original: Fixed OSC 7501 terminal status showing the session as done while the agent was paused waiting for background subagents or tasks to finish; the terminal's tab or window now shows it as working until that work ends, and daemon tasks such as dev servers don't count.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁操作與選單問題修復
title.en: Fix Remote Control Browser Input and Menu Issues

body.zh-TW:
用手機或電腦瀏覽器連回來發訊息、滑動長對話或挑選項時，畫面原本有幾處會卡住或亂跳。

在 Android 的 Chrome 用螢幕鍵盤打字時，`Backspace` 不再突然刪不動、後續文字也不會插進單字中間。使用輸入法或手機選字建議後按 `Enter`，會直接送出訊息而不是換行。

代理回覆特別長時，往上捲動想回到自己的提問，畫面不會再莫名跳回底下。

若你設定了 `ask` 規則或 hook（特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）要求每次確認，權限提示裡不可用的「一律允許」選項，現在用數字鍵或方向鍵也會跳過，跟滑鼠點擊一樣。

連線或伺服器短暫出錯時，模型選單不會再跳成 `No Model Selected`，而是保留你原本的帳號與模型清單直到下次更新成功。
body.en:
When connecting from a phone or desktop browser to send messages, scroll through long conversations, or pick options, several parts of the interface could previously freeze or jump.

When typing with the on-screen keyboard in Chrome on Android, `Backspace` no longer stops deleting characters, and subsequent text no longer lands in the middle of a word. Pressing `Enter` after using an input method or phone keyboard suggestions now sends the message instead of adding a new line.

When the agent's reply is especially long, scrolling up to return to your own prompt no longer unexpectedly jumps back to the bottom.

If you configured an `ask` rule or a hook (a small program triggered by specific events) requiring confirmation each time, the unavailable "always allow" option in the permission prompt is now skipped by number and arrow keys, matching mouse clicks.

During a brief connection or server error, the model menu no longer switches to `No Model Selected`, keeping your existing account and model list until the next successful refresh.

items.original:
Fixed typing in the Remote Control browser view: with Chrome on Android, `Backspace` on the on-screen keyboard could stop deleting characters and later text could land in the middle of a word, and after typing with an input method or a phone keyboard's suggestions, `Enter` could add a new line instead of sending your message.
Fixed scrolling up through a long agent turn in the Remote Control browser view, where the view could jump back down instead of reaching your prompt.
Fixed the permission prompt in the Remote Control browser view letting the number or arrow keys select and submit an unavailable "always allow" option when one of your ask rules or a hook requires you to confirm each time; the keyboard now skips those options, as clicking already did.
Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view switching to `No Model Selected` after a brief connection or server error; it now keeps your account and model list until the next successful refresh.

entries: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.
Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.
Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.
Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.

Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.
Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

title.zh-TW: 新增 run_workflow 分派多代理工作流
title.en: Added run_workflow to dispatch multi-agent workflows

body.zh-TW:
手邊有一大疊會議紀錄想同時摘要、分類再彙整成總表，過去得盯著畫面一步步下指令。現在所有人都能用 `run_workflow` 工具，讓代理程式直接跑一段 Python 工作流腳本。它會把任務平行或分階段拆給多個子代理（幫忙分頭做事的助手），最後再把結果收攏起來。

就算電腦沒裝過 Python 也能照跑，因為這個工具直接用 CLI（文字指令介面）內建的版本來執行。⟦以前像你一個人扛著掃把從客廳掃到陽台，現在則像班長開出一張掃除表，同時派同學擦窗和拖地，等地板乾了再叫下一組人排桌椅。⟧
body.en:
When you had a stack of meeting notes to summarize, categorize, and compile into a master table, you used to watch the screen and give commands step by step. Now everyone can use the `run_workflow` tool to have the agent run a Python workflow script directly. It splits tasks across multiple subagents (helpers that divide up the work) in parallel or in stages, then combines the results.

It still runs even if Python is not installed on your computer, because the tool uses the version bundled with the CLI (text-based command interface). ⟦Before, you had to carry a broom from the living room to the balcony all by yourself; now a class monitor posts a chore chart, sends classmates to wipe windows and mop floors at the same time, and waits for the floor to dry before having the next group arrange the desks and chairs.⟧

items.original: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

title.zh-TW: 管理員設定新增 pluginControls 管控外掛
title.en: Added pluginControls to admin settings for plugin management

body.zh-TW:
沒有購買 Gemini Enterprise 的公司，管理員過去沒辦法統一控管外掛。現在管理員設定新增 `pluginControls` 區塊，提供外掛控制項。

`pluginsDisabled` 不只會禁止安裝或啟用外掛，連內建外掛都會被擋下無法載入。`marketplaceDisabled` 則會關閉外掛市集，保留已經裝好的外掛繼續運作。原本就使用 Gemini Enterprise 的組織，依然照各自的 Cloud Console 政策走，不受影響。⟦過去沒買企業平台就只能放任大家自己裝外掛，現在像在賣場拆掉新貨架不准再上架，或乾脆把整間店的電源總閘拉下來，連原本附的設備都停轉。⟧
body.en:
For companies that have not purchased Gemini Enterprise, admins previously had no way to manage plugins centrally. Now admin settings include a `pluginControls` section with plugin controls.

`pluginsDisabled` not only blocks installing or enabling plugins, it also stops built-in plugins from loading. `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace while keeping already installed plugins working. Organizations already using Gemini Enterprise continue to follow their own Cloud Console policies without any change. ⟦Without the enterprise platform, you had to let everyone install plugins on their own; now it is like removing new shelves in a store so nothing more can go on display, or pulling the main power breaker for the whole shop so even the built-in equipment stops running.⟧

items.original: Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

title.zh-TW: Auto mode 審查跨沙盒指令變快也更少逾時
title.en: Faster Auto mode review with fewer timeouts for cross-sandbox commands

body.zh-TW: 打開 Auto mode 執行可能跨出終端機沙盒（限制程式活動的安全隔離區）的指令時，過去常要等很久才等到審查結果，甚至等到失敗。現在審查機制能直接搜尋對話內容、列出資料夾並搜尋檔案，不用再為了每次確認都另起一個隔離指令來查，因此判斷更快、也更不容易逾時。⟦跟進無塵室查資料一樣，以前每確認一個細節都得重穿全套防護衣進去一趟，難怪動不動就逾時；現在直接在門口翻紀錄就能放行。⟧
body.en: When turning on Auto mode to run commands that might step outside the terminal sandbox (an isolated safety zone that restricts what programs can do), you often had to wait a long time for a review result, or even see it fail. Now the reviewer can directly search the conversation, list folders, and search files instead of starting a separate isolated command for each check, so decisions are faster and less likely to time out. ⟦Picture checking records in a cleanroom: before, you had to put on a full protective suit and go inside for every single detail, which easily timed out; now you can flip through the logs right at the door and approve it.⟧

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

title.zh-TW: /resume 載入變快且支援唯一前綴指定對話
title.en: Faster /resume loading and unique prefix matching for conversations

body.zh-TW:
在很長的工作階段想用 `/resume` 接回舊對話，挑選清單以前會去抓所有開啟對話的完整紀錄，常卡在 `Loading conversations...`。現在清單不再預先抓取全部歷史紀錄，打開就會順暢許多。

直接輸入 `/resume <id>` 時，只要輸入的前綴剛好只對到一個對話（例如狀態列顯示的短編號），就能直接跳轉。要是輸入了找不到的編號，現在會明確回報 `conversation <id> not found`，不再默默打開挑選清單。⟦開通訊錄找人時也一樣，以前得先把每位聯絡人的全套檔案搬上桌才讓你挑，現在只列清單就能選，打上開頭幾碼還能直接命中。⟧
body.en:
When using `/resume` to pick up an old conversation in a long session, the picker used to fetch the full history of every open conversation and often stalled on `Loading conversations...`. Now the list no longer fetches all history upfront, so opening it is much smoother.

When typing `/resume <id>` directly, as long as the prefix you enter matches just one conversation (such as the short ID shown in the status line), it jumps straight there. If you enter an ID that cannot be found, it now clearly reports `conversation <id> not found` instead of silently opening the picker. ⟦Like looking someone up in an address book, before you had to haul every contact's complete file onto the desk just to pick one; now a simple list lets you choose, and typing the first few characters jumps straight to a match.⟧

items.original: Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.

title.zh-TW: /browser 工作階段錄影改存 .mp4 檔
title.en: /browser session recordings now save as .mp4 files

body.zh-TW: 請瀏覽器子代理用 `/browser` 操作網頁並錄下工作階段時，過去存出來的檔案格式是 `.webm`。現在改成透過 Chrome 內建的螢幕錄製功能進行錄影，存下來的檔案格式也換成 `.mp4`。
body.en: When asking the browser subagent to operate web pages with `/browser` and record the session, the saved file format used to be `.webm`. Now it records through Chrome's built-in screen recording feature, and the saved file format is `.mp4` instead.

items.original: Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

title.zh-TW: 修補 HTTP MCP 轉址時外洩自訂標頭的漏洞
title.en: Patched HTTP MCP redirect leak of custom headers

body.zh-TW: 透過 HTTP 連線的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，可以設定 API Key 這類自訂標頭。過去只要該伺服器回傳轉址，這些標頭就可能跟著被轉送給另一個主機。現在這個安全漏洞已經修好，自訂標頭只會送往你原本設定好的伺服器來源，不會跟著轉送到別的主機。⟦拿著寫有密語的信封去拜訪合作店家也一樣，以前對方門口貼條子叫你改去別家，你順手就把密函交給新地址；現在只有原本約好的店才收得到。⟧
body.en: For an HTTP-connected MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server, you can configure custom headers such as API keys. Previously, whenever that server returned a redirect, those headers could be forwarded along to another host. That security issue is now fixed, so custom headers are sent only to the server origin you originally configured and will not be forwarded to other hosts. ⟦Think of visiting a partner shop with a sealed envelope containing a secret phrase: before, if a note on the door told you to go to another shop instead, you handed the secret letter to the new address; now only the shop you originally arranged with can receive it.⟧

items.original: Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再受理異常視窗尺寸以免卡死
title.en: Terminal no longer accepts implausible window sizes that cause freezes

body.zh-TW: 終端機偶爾會從亂掉的控制序列收到負數或極端龐大的長寬數字，過去這會害 CLI 當場凍結或吃掉大量記憶體。這個問題已經修好，現在遇到格式錯誤或不合理的尺寸回報會直接忽略。
body.en: The terminal occasionally receives negative or extremely large width and height numbers from stray escape sequences, which used to make the CLI freeze on the spot or use excessive memory. This issue is now fixed, and malformed or implausible size reports are ignored.

items.original: Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy acp 登入備援與錯誤回報等問題
title.en: Fixed agy acp login fallback, error reporting, and related issues

body.zh-TW:
跑完 `agy acp --login` 後，如果 `settings.json` 裡指定的驗證方式沒有對應憑證，工作階段過去會報錯 `Authentication required`。例如設定了 `gemini-api-key` 卻沒給 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 時，現在 CLI 會改用你存好的登入紀錄當備援，不會直接失敗。

ACP 客戶端傳入的 MCP 伺服器名稱如果帶有空白或其他特殊字元，送出的提示詞現在也能正常執行，不再失敗。

回合失敗時，以前只會籠統顯示 `Agent execution terminated due to error.`，現在會回報模型錯誤或額度不足等具體原因。

對串接 ACP 客戶端的開發者來說，編輯完成後送出的差異比對內容，修改前後兩段文字結尾不會再多帶一個換行。
body.en:
After running `agy acp --login`, if the authentication method specified in `settings.json` has no matching credential, the session used to fail with `Authentication required`. For example, when `gemini-api-key` is set without `GEMINI_API_KEY`, the CLI now falls back to your saved login instead of failing right away.

Prompts now run normally instead of failing when an ACP client passes an MCP server name containing spaces or other special characters.

When a turn fails, instead of showing only the generic `Agent execution terminated due to error.`, it now reports the specific reason, such as a model or quota error.

For developers integrating ACP clients, diffs sent after edits are completed no longer include an extra trailing newline in the before and after text.

items.original: Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

title.zh-TW: 含 UTF-8 BOM 標記的設定與驗證檔不再失靈
title.en: Config and auth files with UTF-8 BOM markers no longer fail

body.zh-TW:
有些檔案存檔時會在開頭加上 UTF-8 BOM（一種隱藏的編碼標記），過去這類檔案常會讓讀取動作出錯，現在幾項主要問題都已經修好。

在 `settings.json` 寫入 `"modelProvider"` 後，第一次執行就會直接套用。`agy acp` 也能正確讀取你的設定與驗證選項，不再退回預設的備援設定。

用 `agy plugin validate` 檢查帶有這種標記的 `hooks.json` 時，現在會跑完所有檢查，並指出真正的語法錯誤和行號，不再怪罪給 BOM。
body.en:
Some files are saved with a UTF-8 BOM (a hidden encoding marker) at the beginning, which used to cause read errors, and several major issues with this are now fixed.

When `"modelProvider"` is written in `settings.json`, it is now applied on the first run. `agy acp` also loads your settings and authentication options properly instead of falling back to defaults.

When checking a `hooks.json` with this marker using `agy plugin validate`, it now runs all checks and points out the actual syntax error and line number instead of blaming the BOM.

items.original: Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端接續對話並帶入 -i 提示詞的錯誤
title.en: Fixed resuming remote conversations with -i prompts

body.zh-TW:
從指令列同時帶上 `--remote-agent` 與 `--conversation` 或 `--continue` 接續對話，以前若再補上互動提示詞參數就會出錯。一旦一併傳入 `-i` 或 `--prompt-interactive`，這個提示詞不會送進舊對話，反而會意外開出一串新對話。

這個問題已經修好，現在會先等舊對話紀錄載入完成，再把提示詞送進該對話。這段提示詞也會像手動輸入一樣立刻出現在畫面，若前一輪還在跑就乖乖排隊，送出失敗也會回報。
body.en:
When resuming a conversation from the command line with `--remote-agent` together with `--conversation` or `--continue`, adding an interactive prompt flag used to cause an error. Passing `-i` or `--prompt-interactive` at the same time would unexpectedly start a new conversation instead of sending the prompt into the old one.

This is now fixed: it waits for the old conversation history to finish loading before sending the prompt into that conversation. The prompt also appears on screen right away like typed input, queues up if the previous turn is still running, and reports if sending fails.

items.original: Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版 `!` 指令保留引號並連動關閉子程式
title.en: Windows `!` Commands Keep Quotes and Close Child Programs

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上用 `!` 執行殼層指令，PowerShell 過去會吃掉雙引號，像是 `! git commit -m "two words"` 沒辦法照原樣執行。現在雙引號會完整保留，指令怎麼打就怎麼跑。

在工作面板強制結束任務或直接離開 CLI 時，過去由 `!` 啟動的程式會被留在背景繼續跑，任務狀態也一直顯示執行中。現在關閉 CLI 或中止任務時，會一併結束那些啟動的程式，不再放著繼續跑。
body.en:
When running shell commands with `!` on Windows, PowerShell used to strip double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` could not run as typed. Double quotes are now preserved, so commands run exactly as entered.

When killing a task in the tasks panel or quitting the CLI directly, programs started by `!` used to stay running in the background while the task remained marked as running. Closing the CLI or stopping the task now ends those started programs as well instead of leaving them running.

items.original: Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.

title.zh-TW: Windows SSH 下 /copy 可正常複製進本機
title.en: Windows /copy over SSH Now Copies to Local Clipboard

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 遠端連到 Windows 執行 CLI，使用 `/copy` 或其他剪貼簿動作時，過去複製的文字送不到本機剪貼簿。這些文字還會被寫進 CLI 的紀錄檔裡。這個問題已經修好，現在內容會正常進到你的本機剪貼簿，也不再寫入紀錄檔。
body.en: When running the CLI on Windows over an SSH connection and using `/copy` or other clipboard actions, copied text used to fail to reach your local clipboard. That text was also written into the CLI log file. This is now fixed, so copied content goes to your local clipboard as expected and is no longer written to the log file.

items.original: Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 排程自動化漏掉多行提示詞
title.en: Fix Missing Multi-Line Prompts in Windows Scheduled Automations

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上讓任務照時間表自動跑，若內容寫了好幾行，以前執行時卻只收得到第一行。這個問題已經修好，現在不管是時間到了自動執行，還是由你手動觸發，每一次都會完整拿到整份提示詞。
body.en: When running tasks on a schedule on Windows, multi-line prompts used to deliver only the first line when executed. This is now fixed, so every run receives the full prompt whether it runs on schedule or is triggered manually.

items.original: Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

title.zh-TW: macOS 版不再每小時重複跳出鑰匙圈錯誤視窗
title.en: macOS No Longer Repeats Keychain Error Dialogs Hourly

body.zh-TW:
Mac 用戶要是遇上系統鑰匙圈寫入失敗，過去畫面上大約每小時就會跳出一次 `Keychain Not Found` 視窗。原因是 CLI 每次更新登入 token（用來驗證身分的授權令牌）都會再試著寫進鑰匙圈。

這個問題已經修好，現在只要寫入失敗，在這次工作階段剩下的時間裡，CLI 會改把登入資料存進檔案，不再一直重試鑰匙圈。
body.en:
For Mac users whose system keychain write fails, a `Keychain Not Found` dialog used to pop up about once an hour. This happened because the CLI retried writing to the keychain every time it refreshed the sign-in token (an authorization credential for verifying identity).

This is now fixed: once a write fails, the CLI saves sign-in data to a file for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain.

items.original: Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.

title.zh-TW: MCP 與外掛的啟動和登入不再無故失敗
title.en: MCP and Plugin Startup and Sign-In No Longer Fail Unexpectedly

body.zh-TW:
連上 MCP 伺服器或替外掛進行帳號驗證，過去有幾種情況很容易讓工作卡在半路。

幾個子代理正準備啟動時若剛好重新載入 MCP 伺服器，過去可能意外開出重複的伺服器程式，害部分子代理的工具失效或登入失敗。這個問題已經修好，重載伺服器時不會再因此開出重複程序。

在沒有 IPv4 本機位址的機器上，例如純 IPv6 虛擬機，替 MCP 或外掛做 OAuth（網頁跳轉授權登入機制）時，過去會毫無反應就失敗。現在只要連不上 `127.0.0.1`，登入回傳網址就會自動改用 `[::1]` 當備援。

從 `/plugin` 登入外掛帳號時，有時流程其實已經成功了，畫面卻偶爾誤報尚未完成，現在登入完成後會正確反映成功狀態。
body.en:
Connecting to MCP servers or signing in to plugins used to stall midway in a few situations.

If MCP servers were reloaded just as several subagents were starting, duplicate server processes could accidentally launch, breaking tools or causing sign-ins to fail for some subagents. This is now fixed, so reloading servers no longer spawns duplicate processes.

On machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs, running OAuth (a web-redirect authorization sign-in flow) for MCP or plugins used to fail silently. Now, whenever `127.0.0.1` is unreachable, the sign-in callback URL automatically falls back to `[::1]`.

When signing in to a plugin account from `/plugin`, the screen sometimes wrongly reported that sign-in had not finished even though it had succeeded; it now accurately reflects the completed status.

items.original:
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.
Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

title.zh-TW: 按 Ctrl+O 展開工具群組不再跳位或漏摘要
title.en: Expanding Tool Groups with Ctrl+O No Longer Jumps or Drops Summaries

body.zh-TW:
按下 `Ctrl+O` 展開畫面的工具群組，過去整塊介面常會跟著上下亂跑。這個問題已經修好，現在收合提示會留在與展開提示同一行，展開時畫面不會再跳位。

在低詳細度模式下，展開後的畫面過去會漏掉 token（計算文字用量的單位）摘要行，現在這行資訊也會一起顯示出來。
body.en:
Pressing `Ctrl+O` to expand tool groups on screen used to cause the interface to jump up and down. This is now fixed: the collapse hint stays on the same line as the expand hint, so the view no longer shifts when expanded.

In low verbosity mode, the expanded view used to drop the token (the unit used to measure text usage) summary line, which now appears as well.

items.original: Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.

title.zh-TW: 修正手機遠端控制網頁無法往下滑選模型的問題
title.en: Fix Touch Scrolling in Phone Remote Control Model Selector

body.zh-TW: 拿著手機開瀏覽器遙控、想挑別的選項時，以前手指撥過第一屏清單就會卡住，排在後面的怎麼點都選不到。這個問題已經修好，現在在遠端控制網頁裡能用手指正常往下滑動，選取清單後段的模型。
body.en: When using a phone browser for Remote Control and trying to pick a different option, scrolling used to get stuck after the first screen of the list, making items further down impossible to tap. This is now fixed, so you can scroll down smoothly by touch in the Remote Control web view and select models near the end of the list.

items.original: Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

entries: Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen through an enterprise model gateway.

Added click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: clicking a tool group, a thought, a prompt's attached images, or multi-line command output now expands or collapses just that item, so you no longer have to use `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` is unchanged.

Added context window usage updates to `agy acp` sessions, so editors such as JetBrains AI Chat can show how much of the model's context window the conversation is using; the value is sent when a session starts or is reloaded, after each model call, and after a model or thinking level change.

Added support for two admin settings: `gateway.routeWebFetch` stops the agent's web page reads from going around an enterprise model gateway by disabling URL reading unless a `proxy.address` is configured, and `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` lets an organization turn off Remote Control. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (through `proxy.address` when set) instead of through Google's fetch service.

Improved the first message of a conversation in `--remote-agent` sessions, which no longer waits for its remote environment to start or resume: the CLI now prepares a new conversation's environment as soon as the session knows its remote project, and again after `/new` or switching projects, and starts a resumed conversation's idle environment in the background as soon as it opens with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`.

Fixed a security issue in the terminal sandbox's network proxy where a command could get around path-based network rules, such as those limiting where credentials are sent or which Git and API paths are allowed, by using percent-encoded slashes (`%2F`), backslashes, or `..` segments in a URL path; every way of reading the path is now checked against the rules, and the cleaned-up path is the one sent upstream.

Fixed always-allow command rules on Windows so they can no longer be bypassed when the shell is `cmd`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, or a full path to one of them. Commands run in PowerShell or Command Prompt now always need an exact match, because their quoting rules differ from POSIX shells. A command with hidden extra statements, such as `git status '&& del secret.txt'`, could otherwise be approved by a rule meant only for `git status`.

Fixed permission rules for MCP tools, such as an `mcp(server/tool)` deny or ask rule, being ignored for MCP tools that are loaded up front (marked eager in `mcp_config.json`) and for the `/browser` subagent's Chrome DevTools tools; these tools now ask for approval or are blocked according to your rules, like other MCP tools.

Fixed `/plugin`, `agy plugin`, and headless `-p` runs ignoring your organization's Gemini Enterprise admin controls for plugins: when an administrator disables plugins, installing, importing, or enabling one now fails with `plugins are disabled by your organization`, and when the plugin marketplace is disabled, marketplace catalogs are not fetched and marketplace installs fail; listing, disabling, and uninstalling plugins still work.

Fixed hook commands on Windows that contain double quotes, such as `type "C:\my dir\deny.json"`, failing and being silently skipped, which let a `PreInvocation` or `PreToolUse` hook that should block the agent go unenforced; hook commands are now passed to `cmd.exe` exactly as written.

Fixed files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as Windows PowerShell, Visual Studio, and Notepad's "UTF-8 with BOM" option do, being silently ignored: `settings.json` and files passed to `--settings` are no longer rejected as malformed, a `hooks.json` no longer leaves `/hooks` empty with none of its hooks running, and custom agent and rule files no longer go missing from `/agents` and the agent picker or lose their frontmatter trigger.

Fixed opening your external editor on Windows when `EDITOR` or the `Editor` setting is a normal Windows path such as `C:\Tools\ed.cmd` or `"C:\Program Files\Vim\vim.exe"`; backslashes were dropped, so `Ctrl+G`, `/open`, `/keybindings`, and artifact review failed with an `editor ... not found in PATH` error.

Fixed `!` shell commands hanging forever with no output when the command wrote a lot to stderr, which was easy to hit on Windows with build tools that print progress or warnings to stderr; such commands now finish and show their stdout and stderr lines in the order they were written.

Fixed agent turns failing when a network connection silently went stale or the network dropped a shared HTTP/2 connection, for example with `http2: client connection force closed via ClientConn.Close` or after a socket write error; model requests now retry on a fresh connection and, if retries run out, show the CLI's network error message. Slow model responses also no longer time out after 60 seconds when an organization's admin settings configure a proxy or custom CA certificate.

Fixed the CLI sometimes never exiting after a session, and background requests such as generating a conversation title, worktree name, or commit message hanging, when the model answered one of those requests with an unexpectedly long reply.

Fixed a single empty or corrupted queued message file, for example one left behind by an unclean shutdown, blocking every later message to the agent, so background task completions, timers, and subagent replies no longer silently stop reaching it; the unreadable file is set aside and the remaining messages are delivered.

Fixed remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth without a client secret signing you out as soon as the access token expired, typically after an hour; token refreshes now send the client ID the way the server requires, so you stay signed in, including with sign-ins saved by earlier versions.

Fixed the agent telling you to click a Sign in button or use an Accounts tab, which the CLI doesn't have, when a plugin or plugin MCP server needs you to sign in; it now tells you to sign in with `/plugin` and then send a message to continue, and `/mcp` shows the same `/plugin` guidance for a server that is waiting on a sign-in.
Fixed switching a conversation from a Gemini model to a custom or admin-managed non-Gemini model, such as Claude, failing with an `Invalid signature in thinking block` error.

Fixed `/btw` and `/help` side questions failing with `stream timed out after 5m0s` while the side question was still working: they now run until they finish or you press `Esc`, which the `Thinking...` line and the "already in progress" message now mention, and a side question that needs an approval the card can't show stops right away and tells you to ask in the main conversation instead.

Fixed `/learn` repeatedly appending to rule files such as `GEMINI.md` or `AGENTS.md` until they grew past the rule size limit, after which their endings were silently cut off on every turn. Before updating a rule, `/learn` now checks the documented size limits, and when an update would get close to or exceed them, it proposes condensing existing entries, splitting them into a scoped rule, or moving step-by-step guidance into a skill.

Fixed follow-up turns in a `--json-schema` conversation resumed with `--conversation` ending on a plain-text reply with no structured result once an earlier turn had produced one; each new message now gets its own reminders to return the structured output, up to the usual limit per message.
Fixed `/rewind` failing with a `step_index out of bounds` error when you pressed `Esc` while a turn was still starting and then rewound to remove that message.

Fixed `/diff` showing a made-up change at the end of a turn's diff for files larger than 500 KB when an earlier edit changed the file's length; the two versions are now cut off at the same line, so the preview shows only real edits.

Fixed `/` search in the artifact viewer missing text split across different styles, such as a sentence containing a number or inline code, and leaving the rest of a styled line unstyled after a highlighted match; the current match is also now easier to pick out from the other matches in every color scheme.

Fixed status messages such as "Copied 3 lines (42 characters)" after selecting text, settings save errors, and permission reload notices never appearing when you use a custom status line; they now briefly replace your custom status line, which comes back once the message clears, without shifting the layout.
Fixed the in-progress spinner line freezing until you restarted the CLI after you logged out while the agent was working and then signed back in; it now keeps animating.

title.zh-TW: /model 新增 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 與 Carbon 模型支援
title.en: /model Adds Support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon Models

body.zh-TW: 當你想嘗試最新一代模型來處理日常任務時，現在可以直接切換到 Gemini 4 系列。⟦如同工具行進駐新一代動力機具，架上依照出力大小整齊陳列，只要憑會員卡或企業通行證就能隨時提領使用。⟧透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線時，`/model` 與 `--model` 迎來了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen（提供 Low、Medium、High 與 XHigh 四種思考強度）。選單也同步加入了 Gemini 4 Carbon（提供 Low、Medium 與 High 三種思考強度）。如果你習慣使用應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入，同樣可以使用這四種強度的 Hydrogen 模型。而在透過企業模型閘道連線的工作環境裡，也已經支援使用 Gemini 4 Hydrogen。
body.en: When you want to try the latest generation of models for everyday tasks, you can now switch straight to the Gemini 4 family. ⟦A hardware store stocks a new line of power tools, arranged neatly on the shelves by output size, ready to check out anytime with a membership card or corporate pass.⟧ When connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `/model` and `--model` now include Gemini 4 Hydrogen (offering Low, Medium, High, and XHigh thinking levels). The menu also adds Gemini 4 Carbon (offering Low, Medium, and High thinking levels). If you prefer signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), you can use all four thinking levels of Hydrogen as well. Environments connecting through an enterprise model gateway also support Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕渲染模式支援點擊展開，免按快速鍵收合單一區塊
title.en: Click to Expand Single Blocks in Full Screen Rendering Mode Without Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡閱讀長篇回應與工具記錄時，若想確認某段內容，翻找起來常需要反覆切換檢視。⟦就像閱讀互動式摺疊目錄一樣，以前想看細節必須按下開關整批掀開，現在只要用滑鼠輕點目標，就能單獨展開或收起該段落。⟧在全螢幕 `full screen (altscreen)` 渲染模式下，終端機介面新增了滑鼠點擊展開機制。現在只要點擊工具分組、思考過程、提示詞隨附的圖片，或是多行指令輸出，就能直接展開或摺疊特定項目。你不必再透過 `Ctrl+O` 鍵來回切換。預設的渲染模式（Rendering Mode）則維持原樣。
body.en: When reading long responses and tool logs in the terminal, checking a specific section often meant toggling views back and forth. ⟦Picture an interactive folding catalog where you previously had to flip a switch to open everything at once for details, whereas now a click on one target expands or collapses just that section.⟧ In the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, the terminal interface now supports click-to-expand. Clicking a tool group, a thought, images attached to a prompt, or multi-line command output now directly expands or collapses that specific item. You no longer need to toggle back and forth with `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` remains unchanged.

items.original: Added click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: clicking a tool group, a thought, a prompt's attached images, or multi-line command output now expands or collapses just that item, so you no longer have to use `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 即時回報上下文用量，編輯器可顯示使用比例
title.en: agy acp Reports Context Usage in Real Time for Editor Indicators

body.zh-TW: 當你在外部編輯器裡調用助手時，常想掌握對話佔據了模型多少記憶容量。⟦類似儀表板即時顯示油量，車輛啟動、行駛加速或變更檔位時指針都會更新，駕駛隨時能掌握剩餘行駛額度。⟧在 `agy acp` 建立的工作階段中，現在會主動回報上下文視窗（模型單次能容納的文字量）的使用進度。這讓 JetBrains AI Chat 等外接編輯器能夠即時顯示對話佔用的比例。該數值會在工作階段剛啟動或重新載入時送出。每當模型完成一次呼叫，或是你切換模型與調整思考層級時，終端機也會立即推送最新用量。
body.en: When calling the assistant from an external editor, it helps to know how much of the model's memory capacity your conversation is taking up. ⟦Like a dashboard fuel gauge updating in real time, the needle moves when the car starts, accelerates, or shifts gears so the driver always knows the remaining range.⟧ Sessions created by `agy acp` now actively report usage progress for the context window (the amount of text a model can hold at once). This lets external editors such as JetBrains AI Chat display the conversation's usage ratio in real time. The value is sent when a session starts or reloads. Whenever a model call finishes, or when you switch models or adjust the thinking level, the CLI also pushes the latest usage immediately.

items.original: Added context window usage updates to `agy acp` sessions, so editors such as JetBrains AI Chat can show how much of the model's context window the conversation is using; the value is sent when a session starts or is reloaded, after each model call, and after a model or thinking level change.

title.zh-TW: 新增企業管理員設定，可嚴格控管網頁讀取與停用遠端操控
title.en: New Enterprise Admin Settings Restrict Web Reads and Disable Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 企業在落實資安合規政策時，常需要集中管理員工終端對外連線與遠端存取權限。⟦宛若大樓管委會為辦公室出入口設定門禁規範，既能關閉遠端遙控門鎖，也能強制所有包裹必須經由指定櫃檯轉交。⟧新增的 `gateway.routeWebFetch` 設定鍵可防止代理人讀取網頁時繞過企業模型閘道。除非額外配置了 `proxy.address`，否則會直接停用讀取網址的功能。在搭配企業模型閘道的情況下，網頁會改由你的電腦直接抓取（有配置時走 `proxy.address` 轉發），不再經過 Google 的抓取服務。另一項 `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` 則能讓組織停用遠端操控（Remote Control）功能。
body.en: When enforcing security compliance policies, enterprises often need centralized control over outbound terminal connections and remote access permissions. ⟦Think of a building management committee setting access rules for office entrances, able to disable remote-controlled locks while requiring every package to pass through a designated front desk.⟧ The new `gateway.routeWebFetch` setting prevents the agent from bypassing an enterprise model gateway when reading web pages. Unless `proxy.address` is also configured, URL reading is disabled outright. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (routed through `proxy.address` when configured) instead of through Google's fetch service. Another setting, `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled`, lets organizations turn off Remote Control.

items.original: Added support for two admin settings: `gateway.routeWebFetch` stops the agent's web page reads from going around an enterprise model gateway by disabling URL reading unless a `proxy.address` is configured, and `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` lets an organization turn off Remote Control.
